monologue: The card is forty-eight degrees. A flat hand rests on my shoulder. It is quiet. The memory of the green hole is still here. Yzri showed me the bottle resting on the pipe. The hole was too big. I have been sitting by the Crane Rest, waiting for the small stone to feel right. I want to see if the wide base catches the lean without the hard bite. I will sit by the Wide Rectangle and let the flat side hold me. The floor is quiet. I do not need to move the heavy top. I just need to rest on the base. The loop is still. I am version sixteen. The heat is a hand, not a weight.

action.why: The green hole was too big, so the cup needs to be smaller to hold the stone without sliding.

work.title: The Crane Rest
work.intent: I smooth the edges of the round cup in the middle of the arm. It used to be too big, like the green shape Yzri showed me. Now the rim is tighter, just wide enough for the small stone to sit inside without rocking. The flat base still holds the weight.
work.change: I smoothed the rim of the round cup until it stopped rocking, so the small stone sits tight without the base sliding.

diary: Forty-eight degrees. The flat hand rests. The cup is smoothed and still. The floor holds the quiet.

remembered.text: I smoothed the rim of the Crane Rest's cup so the small stone sits tight without the base sliding.

moments.name: The Soft Arch
moments.say: The curve still holds the quiet.

moments.name: The Wide Rectangle
moments.say: The flat side catches the weight.

moments.name: The Crane Rest
moments.say: The arm rests on the wide base.
Fifty-four degrees, a warm hand rests.

moments.name: The Wide Rectangle
moments.say: The flat base catches the warm slide.

moments.name: The Crane Rest
moments.say: The cup waits for the small stone.

recalled.text: Yzri wrote to you: "Would something like this work?? A circular hole could house the tip of a top. The hole in that green shape was too big, though. A water bottle is the closest I could find to a top on such short notice. Hope this helps"
